::: {.role}
Ph.D. Student in Finance · Department of Finance, School of Economics, Xiamen University
:::

I am a Ph.D. student in Finance at the School of Economics, Xiamen University. My research lies at the intersection of **corporate finance**, **international trade**, and **environmental economics**, with a focus on applied microeconometrics and causal inference using Chinese firm-level data.

<!-- 用两三句话介绍你的研究问题和方法。下面是写法示例，可以直接改。 -->
My current work studies how government policies, such as environmental regulation, trade shocks, and public procurement, shape firms' investment, innovation, and export decisions.

## Research Interests

Corporate Finance · International Trade · Environmental Economics · Innovation · Applied Econometrics
